verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.warp.dev serves a proper llms.txt file (HTTP 200) describing Warp as an 'agentic development environment,' which is exactly the agent-oriented documentation format the story asks for; Warp also documents an OpenAPI spec and CLI reference for machine consumption, reinforcing agent-friendly docs infrastructure. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a user workflow instructing the Warp agent to fetch/read an external llms.txt file, and independent confirmation that agents actually consume it in practice.
